Hunks of a diff

Source: R/text.R
diff_hunks.Rd

Groups the changes of a diff into hunks, each with up to context unchanged elements around it, as a unified diff shows them. Changes closer together than twice the context share one hunk.

Usage

diff_hunks(d, context = 3L)

Arguments

d

A zudiff object, from diff_vec() or diff_text().

context

The number of unchanged elements to keep on each side of a change.

Value

A list of hunks. Each hunk is a list with old_start, old_len, new_start and new_len, the range it covers in each input as in diff_edits(), and edits, its rows of diff_edits(), with the unchanged runs at its ends cut to the context.

Examples

d <- diff_vec(1:20, c(1:4, 99L, 6:20))
diff_hunks(d, context = 2)
#> [[1]]
#> [[1]]$old_start
#> [1] 3
#> 
#> [[1]]$old_len
#> [1] 5
#> 
#> [[1]]$new_start
#> [1] 3
#> 
#> [[1]]$new_len
#> [1] 5
#> 
#> [[1]]$edits
#>       op old_start old_len new_start new_len
#> 1  equal         3       2         3       2
#> 2 delete         5       1         5       0
#> 3 insert         6       0         5       1
#> 4  equal         6       2         6       2
#> 
#>
